item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Granted, I love the ORIA format and its inner workings as much as the next person. However, the references to Night Vale's Smiling God renders the work somewhat unoriginal. Even if I disregard that bit, the story feels like a traditional "Oh, the horror! The horror!" type of story.

Although I do agree that I like how the djinn react to this Smiling God.

Downvoted overall.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
All I can say is that it will not go corporatist or make visceral technology. It only wants worshippers followers, and that is all. It may or may not be having an existential crisis.

However, it was based on the God of Strexcorp, at least subconsciously. I am writing a secondary memorandum about it currently that will show some key differences. I probably should've posted it alongside this, but I didn't think to make it at the time. Sorry for any plagiarism!

EDIT: Also, it does not:

  • Make things translucent
  • Actually intend for the people to worship it
  • Shine brighter than the Sun(Which is between 50k and 100k lumens)
  • Buzz
  • Harm those who are near it
  • Ever change forms

EDIT(2): Initially, the "Smiling God" thing was just a reference to Night Vale that I slipped in and then when Pig_catapult pointed out the stuff that made it look like plagiarism, I noticed how similar it was to Strexcorp's Smiling God. However, I wouldn't go so far as to say that it is the Smiling God.

item.content:encoded:
Look around you. Strex. Look inside you. Strex. Go to sleep. Strex. Believe in a smiling god. StrexCorp. It is everything.

Collapsing this until a proper investigation is over
– hide block

Seriously, though, this looks like plagiarism in every way.

  • It's a "smiling god"
  • It's made of light
  • It mindrapes people into worshipping it
  • It forces people to smile all the time
  • It is painful for at least non-adherents to be around

Next thing you know it'll go aggressively corporatist, make technology out of human viscera, and eating the universe. Only thing I can say in it's defense is that it's a sphere instead of being locked in another dimension.
